changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO fish_types (id, name, tenant_id) SELECT DISTINCT gen_random_uuid(), fish_type, tenant_id FROM harvest_logs WHERE fish_type IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT gen_random_uuid(), fish_type, tenant_id FROM sample_logs WHERE fish_type IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT gen_random_uuid(), type, tenant_id FROM fish_seeds WHERE type IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT gen_random_uuid(), fish_type, tenant_id FROM fish_stock_events WHERE fish_type IS NOT NULL;
